info.title: Salesforce
info.description: Simulated Salesforce API for deterministic CRM workflow evaluations.

get.summary: Run a SOQL query to search, filter, and fetch Salesforce records using standard SOQL syntax: SELECT fields FROM sObject [WHERE conditions] [ORDER BY field] [LIMIT n].

200.description: {totalSize: int, done: boolean, records: [record], results: [record] (compatibility alias), count: int}

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Complete SOQL query string (e.g., "SELECT Id, Name FROM Contact WHERE LastName = 'Smith'").
